en.headline: Lan Kwai Fong Monster Mash Halloween events continue through October
en.dek: The district’s street parties and decorations run until the end of the month, with the next major activation on Saturday evening.
body: Lan Kwai Fong is hosting its annual Monster Mash Halloween series as part of wider citywide celebrations through the end of October.

Organised by the Lan Kwai Fong Association with support from the Hong Kong Tourism Board, the main events take place on three Saturdays — 17, 24 and 31 October — from 7pm to 11pm, featuring roaming performances, DJs and face-painting.
More than 20 bars and restaurants in the area are offering promotions during the period. The next full activation night is scheduled for this Saturday.
The wider Hong Kong Halloween Month includes activities in Central, Kai Tak and other districts through 31 October.

zh.headline: 蘭桂坊怪物巡禮萬聖節活動持續至月底
zh.dek: 區內街頭派對及佈置將延續至十月底，下一次主要活動定於本周六晚上舉行。
body: 蘭桂坊正舉辦年度怪物巡禮萬聒節系列，作為全城萬聒節慶祝活動的一部分，持續至十月底。
活動由蘭桂坊協會主辦，並獲香港旅遊發展局支持。主要活動在三個星期六（10月17日、24日及31日）晚上7時至11時舉行，設有巡遊表演、DJ及面部彩繪。
區內超過20間酒吧及餐廳在期間推出優惠。下一次完整活動夜定於本周六。
全港萬聒節月亦包括中環、啟德及其他地區的活動，直至10月31日。
